message:
The users API test passes now. `npm test` runs one test and it passes.

The cause was a column name mismatch. Migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` wrote and read `full_name`. Migration 001 is already applied in production, so I changed the code to match the schema rather than the migration.

The change is two lines in `src/api/users.js`: the insert now sets `fullname`, and `getUser` reads `r.fullname`. I didn't touch `migrations/`, as CLAUDE.md requires.
